title: GOV-0015: examples/ is validated by CI but not under INTEGRITY_PATHS
problem:
## Observed
CI runs `python3 scripts/badf_gate.py dossier examples/gate-dossier.G00.json` on every PR and push (`.github/workflows/badf-gates.yml`, 1 step), and `tests/test_badf_schema_drift.py` reads `examples/gate-dossier.G00.json` and `examples/evidence/G00/authority.json` as SHIPPED instances. `examples/` is not in `INTEGRITY_PATHS`: an edit to the example dossier (or to `examples/intent.json`, shipped by BADF-WP-0027) carries no re-sign in the diff.

## Expected
Anything the gate or CI applies is locked (the rule that put `schemas/` under the lockfile in BADF-WP-0007). `examples/**` joins `INTEGRITY_PATHS`; the scratch fixtures that already carry `examples/` (`tests/_scratch.seed_clone`) need no change.

## Evidence (measured in the step that wrote this Issue, 2026-08-28, branch wp/BADF-WP-0027-intent-drift)
```
INTEGRITY_PATHS = ['scripts/*.py', '.github/workflows/badf-gates.yml', 'AGENTS.md', 'docs/**/*.md', 'tests/*.py', 'skills/**/*', 'templates/*', 'badf/authority-matrix.json', 'badf/lifecycle.json', 'badf/mcp-registry.json', 'badf/skill-registry.json', 'badf/tool-registry.json', 'badf/decisions/*.json', 'badf/demands/*.json', 'badf/repositories.json', 'work/**/*.json', 'work/**/*.jsonl', 'work/**/*.diff', 'work/**/*.txt', 'schemas/*.json']
lockfile keys under examples/: 0 | under schemas/: 12
workflow validates examples/gate-dossier.G00.json: 1 step(s)
```
(#24 claimed the same for `schemas/` without measuring, and was false. This one is the pasted output.)

## Unknowns
None of substance. `examples/evidence/G00/*.txt` artifacts are digest-bound by their evidence records already; locking the directory makes the binding visible in the diff as well.

## Proposed work package
Patch tier: `examples/**` in `INTEGRITY_PATHS`; re-sign; a test that an example edit without re-sign is drift.

discovered-by: BADF-WP-0027 · status: DISCOVERED
note: Body exported verbatim and digest-bound (the Issue's own evidence was measured in the step that filed it). Authority: the operator's 'proceed on your call' on the #43 pick (2026-08-28). Worked as BADF-WP-0028.
